selection_rule: The clean thresholds recover less than half of the baseline misses that a geometry-valid linear segment could match. Further recall requires an incremental false profile or a mostly-off-plateau segment.
recommendation: No value and no operating interval. The only caps with zero incremental false profiles are the adjacent grid points 1e-6 and 1.3335e-6, and they recover 0 of 52 geometry-recoverable baseline misses. Every cap that recovers a generated shelf also flags slow slopes or locally flat pieces of a monotone drift. Not written into Classifier v2.
